title: Myelodysplastic Syndrome haematopoietic Stem and Progenitor Cells manuplate bone marrow mesenchymal stromal cells for their advantage
description: We cultured bone marrow haematopoietic stem and progenitor cells with bone marrow mesenchymal stromal cells to understand the interaction between the two cell types. Overall design: Cell were co-cultured either in direct contact or in transwell for 5 days and then each cell type was isolated using FACS. RNA-Seq was performed on the respective cell types.
